I told Pree in their DM that the cutoff is 21 October. They gave me that date on 14 October and haven't changed it since.

The note I saved in gbrain didn't come back. Three lookups returned nothing: by Pree's name, by the question, and by date since 13 October. So I took the answer from their own DM history, where their 14 October message is the only mention.

Two things need attention:
- **The saved note may not be retrievable.** It could be hidden because I marked it private, or the brain's search may be limited because semantic search is turned off. Either way, I can't rely on it for later requests like this one.
- **My earlier wrap-up was posted in Pree's DM.** The summary I wrote to you last time appears in their DM as a separate message. It only repeats their own date, so nothing leaked, but it wasn't meant for them.
